en.title: Scoring via Mobile Application
en.excerpt: Complete guide for referees using mobile scoring from logging in to data synchronization.
en.content:
Scorekeeper Login

The scorekeeper account is created by the committee from the dashboard. Use official credentials so that each score input is recorded in the name of the correct officer.

Scan QR Assignment

Each bearing has a QR assignment. Scan the QR to open the correct match/target and avoid wrong input to other participants.

Input Score

Input the arrow value per end according to the shot sequence. After verification with field officers, save the end so that the data is immediately updated in the central system.

Synchronization and Troubleshooting

  • If the network is unstable, make sure the data is completely saved before moving end.
  • Perform a refresh assignment if the QR does not match the active match.
  • Report data mismatch to dashboard operator for centralized correction.

id.title: Scoring via Aplikasi Mobile
id.excerpt: Panduan lengkap wasit memakai mobile scoring dari login hingga sinkronisasi data.
id.content:
Login Scorekeeper

Akun scorekeeper dibuat oleh panitia dari dashboard. Gunakan kredensial resmi agar setiap input skor tercatat atas nama petugas yang tepat.

Scan QR Assignment

Setiap bantalan memiliki QR assignment. Scan QR untuk membuka match/target yang benar dan menghindari salah input ke peserta lain.

Input Skor

Input nilai panah per end sesuai urutan tembakan. Setelah diverifikasi bersama petugas lapangan, simpan end agar data langsung ter-update di sistem pusat.

Sinkronisasi dan Troubleshooting

  • Jika jaringan tidak stabil, pastikan data benar-benar tersimpan sebelum pindah end.
  • Lakukan refresh assignment bila QR tidak sesuai match aktif.
  • Laporkan mismatch data ke operator dashboard untuk koreksi terpusat.
